pie: h₂éwh₂e wiḱpóteys h₂éHsh₂m̥ h₂usési h₁r̥sḱóh₂. kʷíh₁ h₁ésmey mléwHoh₂? h₁ésmey skʷdʰí. wíḱpotey kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí. deywṓs toy h₁wésuh₂ dh₃ih₁ént. nu h₁ésmey h₂éyesos dóh₃r̥ dh₃dʰí. h₁yód linékʷoh₂ kʷíd wérh₁oh₂? bʰh₂dʰí. stéh₂dʰh₁eh₂ toy h₃pusyéh₁t. h₁íd wérh₁oh₂ ne-kʷe mérsoh₂.
english: Uncle, at dawn I go to the hearth of the clan chief. How shall I speak to him? Say to him: Lord, be well! May the gods give you good things! Then give him the gift of copper. When I leave, what shall I say? Speak: May your herds increase! I will say it, and I will not forget.

pie: kʷésyo ḱwṓ dʰwóri h₁épi ḱéyor? só nos wiḱpóteys ḱwṓ. wiḱpótis kéh₃tum gʷéh₂t ne-kʷe nést. ḱwṓ h₁ím méneti. spéḱye ḱwṓ stéh₂t h₁mé-kʷe próti gʷm̥sḱéti. kʷíd gʰóstey twé próti gʷm̥sḱéti? h₁eǵóh₂ h₁ésyo pótis ǵnéh₃t me. pótey nés.
english: Whose dog is lying by the door? It is the dog of our lord. Our lord went to war and did not come home. The dog waits for him. Look! The dog has stood up and is coming to me. Stranger, why is it coming to you? I am its master: it knew me. Master, you have come home!

pie: h₂éwh₂e wékʷos wóyḱōd mréy h₁épi bʰéroh₂. bʰh₂dʰí kʷíd h₂én ḱléws? wóyḱosyo h₃rḗǵs mért tewh₂téh₂-kʷe néwom h₃réǵm̥ wélh₁t. kʷím wélh₁t? h₃rēǵés népotm̥ h₂yuHn̥ḱóm wiHróm wélh₁t. h₁éy h₁wésus? h₁éy ḱuh₁rós ǵn̥h₃rós-kʷe. swéh₂m tewh₂téh₂m ph₂syéh₁t. nu móri widés? h₁íd widóm méǵh₂ pl̥th₂enóm wódr̥.
english: Grandfather, I bring word from the settlement by the sea. Speak! What did you hear there? The king of the settlement has died, and the people have chosen a new king. Whom did they choose? They chose the king's grandson, a young warrior. Is he good? He is strong and wise. May he guard his own people! And did you see the sea? I saw it: great, wide water.

pie: (h₁)éḱwōs ewewkʷ, "ḱludʰí, h₂ówi! ḱḗrd h₂gʰnutoy widntbʰós: dʰǵʰémō(n), pótis, h₂wlnéh₂m h₂ówyom kʷnewti sébʰoy gʷʰérmom wéstrom; h₂éwibʰoskʷe h₂wlh₂néh₂ né h₁esti."
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: bʰréh₂ter úd stéygʰōwos. sríHgos méǵh₂. h₂óǵmos h₂énǵʰus h₂énh₁mos-kʷe ḱuh₁rós. h₁yégoy mē h₃sléydʰowos. wĺ̥kʷoybʰos bʰebʰóyh₂h₂e. nékʷti péruni h₁sḱónti. péh₂wr̥ dʰéh₁oh₂ wĺ̥kʷōs-kʷe ne gʷémonti. kʷóm h₂óḱrim h₁ludʰṓwos? h₂óḱrim h₂usési h₁ludʰṓwos. nu sédowos.
english: Brother, let us climb up. The cold is great. The way is narrow, and the wind is strong. Let us not slip on the ice! I fear the wolves. At night they are on the mountain. I will lay a fire, and the wolves will not come. When shall we reach the top? At dawn we will arrive at the top. Now let us sit down.

pie: kʷóti nókʷtn̥s h₂énHe h₁iméni widéh₁yōmes? tísrn̥s nókʷtn̥s widéh₁yōmes nu néwom ḱóymom h₁ludʰṓmes. kʷíd nos sénom ḱóymom linkʷmés? dʰéǵʰōm h₂susyét ǵr̥h₂nóm-kʷe ne bʰuHyét. néweh₂ dʰéǵʰōm h₁uséwih₂ h₁éseti? h₁ésyeh₂s sréwmn̥h₂ polh₁úh₂ h₁ésyeh₂s-kʷe gʰréh₁mn̥ bʰérǵʰu. nu h₁eǵóh₂ mudréh₂ h₁ésoh₂. nu ssdʰí wóǵʰos te réydʰeti.
english: Grandmother, how many nights shall we see on the way? We shall see three nights; then we will reach the new village. Why are we leaving our old village? The earth was dry, and the grain did not grow. Will the new earth be good? Its streams are many, and its grass is high. Then I will be glad. Sleep now: the wagon rocks you.

pie: méh₂ter h₁regʷesyéti. kúdʰe ḱósyeh₂i nékʷti légʰowos? h₁énosmi dréwi Hn̥dʰí légʰowos. súHnew dóruh₂ h₁idʰé bʰére péh₂wr̥-kʷe dʰégʷʰēti. kénkoh₂ pódh₁e-kʷe moy ḱm̥h₂tā́m. ḱód mḗms h₁ddʰí wódr̥-kʷe sruméns ph₃dʰí. nékʷts ne dedwóyth₂e? ne dedwóyh₂e péh₂wr̥ nos h₂lékseti. nu ssdʰí bʰéwdʰoh₂.
english: Mother, it is getting dark. Where shall we lie down this night? Let us lie down under that tree. Son, carry wood here, and the fire will burn. I am hungry, and my feet have grown tired. Eat this meat, and drink water from the stream. Are you not afraid of the night? I am not afraid: the fire protects us. Now sleep; I will stay awake.

pie: pótni toy dṓm wiḱyéh₁m̥? góloh₂. príHe gʰóstey gʷm̥dʰí priHós-kʷe nos h₁sdʰí. ph₂wéni h₁épi sddʰí gʷʰr̥dʰí-kʷe. kʷósmōd wóyḱōd gʷegʷómth₂e? wóyḱōd péruni Hn̥dʰí gʷegʷómh₂e. ḱeḱómh₂h₂e. mḗms h₂mélǵos-kʷe h₁áyso. spélom nos toy h₂éyeri wéwkēsi. pótni moy túH ḱéyweh₂.
english: Mistress, may I enter your house? I am freezing. Come, dear guest, and be dear to us. Sit by the fire and grow warm. From which settlement have you come? I have come from the settlement under the mountain. I am weary. Take meat and milk. In the morning you will tell us your tale. Mistress, you are dear to me.

pie: ǵérh₂ont mésgont sóh₂wl̥ gʷéh₂oh₂. kʷíd gʷéh₂esi tósmōd kʷis h₂óǵmōd ne nést. dʰǵʰmés térmn̥ h₂isḱóh₂ méǵh₂-kʷe ḱléwos wénoh₂. h₁yód moy bʰardʰéh₂ kr̥snéh₂ h₁ést ḱléwos h₂isḱóm. pótnih₂m h₂éHsh₂m̥-kʷe réh₁tm̥. tód ḱléwesos h₁wésyos. túH ǵn̥h₃rós h₁eǵóh₂ h₂yuHn̥ḱós. népot n̥syéh₁s.
english: Old man, I will go toward the sinking sun. Why will you go? No one has come home unharmed from that way. I seek the end of the earth, and I will win great fame. When my beard was black, I too was seeking fame. I found a wife and a hearth. That is better than fame. You are wise; I am young. Grandson, may you come home unharmed!

pie: h₂nér te pr̥sḱóh₂ pér me l̥h₁dʰí. kʷís túH kʷíd-kʷe swéh₂m tewh₂téh₂m linékʷs. mórtom kh₃téwi gʷʰénm̥ ǵn̥h₁yóm-kʷe moy h₁mé h₁éǵʰs h₁élh₂t. kʷíd te h₁áyomesdʰh₂? h₁eǵóh₂ ish₁rós stéh₂dʰh₁eh₂ wos wĺ̥kʷoybʰos h₂léksōh₂. bʰoydʰéh₂m nos dh₃dʰí. bʰoydʰéh₂m wos moy dédeh₃mi ne wos dʰréwgʰoh₂. nu pér gʷm̥sḱé gʰóstis-kʷe nos h₁sdʰí.
english: Man, I ask you: let me through. Who are you, and why have you left your own people? In a fight I killed a man, and my kin drove me out. Why should we take you in? I am strong: I will guard your herds from wolves. Give us an oath. I give you my oath: I will not deceive you. Then come through, and be our guest.

pie: ph₂ter tl̥h₂tóm sénom. gʷéwsu Hn̥dʰí Hrunépetor? ne Hrunépetor. h₂éwh₂os moy h₁íd ḱuh₁róh₁ drúh₁ démet. gʷṓs tl̥h₂tóm pér h₂éǵe. h₂ówins pós h₂éǵōh₂. wódr̥ tl̥h₂tóy Hn̥dʰí gʰrémeti. gʷówes tr̥ménti. téḱnom mē bʰéyh₂s. pr̥h₂wóm gʷṓm wédʰe h₂élyōs-kʷe sékʷontor. h₁ím wédʰōh₂ h₂ówins-kʷe h₂éǵēsi.
english: Father, the bridge is old. Will it break under the cattle? It will not break. My grandfather built it with strong timber. Drive the cows across the bridge. Afterwards I will drive the sheep. The water roars under the bridge. The cows are trembling. Do not be afraid, child. Lead the first cow, and the others will follow. I will lead it, and you will drive the sheep.

pie: "tód h₁estu", wéwked lewkós deywós wérunos.
english: "Let this be so," said the bright god Werunos.

pie: kʷíh₁ toy h₁wésuḱlewes néh₂us Hrumptó? ḱl̥nudʰí. mréy h₁r̥h₁yóme pérkʷunos-kʷe stonh₂éyet. h₂énh₁mons h₁íh₂m̥ Hrunépt h₂néres-kʷe ln̥dʰént. nu kʷíh₁ bʰéwgs? dóru lémbʰm̥ dʰéǵʰōm-kʷe snā́m. nu ne h₁r̥h₁yóh₂ h₂ówins péh₂smi. pérkʷunōd bʰebʰóyh₂th₂e? ne bʰebʰóyh₂h₂e h₁ím gʷr̥néHmi.
english: Of-Goodly-Fame, how did your boat break? Listen! We were rowing on the sea, and Perkwunos thundered. The wind broke it, and the men sank. Then how did you get free? I seized timber and swam to the land. Now I do not row: I shepherd sheep. Do you fear Perkwunos? I do not fear him: I praise him.

pie: príHe túH h₁suḱléwēs? h₁eǵóh₂ só kʷís-kʷe túH? ne me memónth₂e? h₁yód h₂yuHn̥ḱóh₁ h₁swé gʷṓs ḱóm ph₂swé. nu te memónh₂e. bʰardʰéh₂ toy kr̥snéh₂ h₁ést nu h₁íh₂ ḱásneh₂. kúdʰe tḱéys? kʷelsóy wóyḱoy tḱḗm. dṓm moy gʷm̥dʰí médʰu-kʷe péh₃owos.
english: Friend, are you Of-Good-Fame? I am he. And who are you? Do you not remember me? When we were young, we herded the cattle together. Now I remember you! Your beard was black; now it is grey. Where have you been dwelling? I dwelt in a distant settlement. Come to my house, and we will drink mead.

pie: h₁yégos déh₂newi tewh₂sós? tetélh₂eti nos? wóǵʰom tetólh₂e. h₂nḗr swóm wóǵʰom dʰǵʰyés h₁ím upér h₁élh₂t. nu h₁ím moḱs térh₂owos. ḱl̥nudʰí h₁yégos bʰindtór. dr̥mdʰí mē-kʷe sth₂éh₁yes. pr̥wé. ǵónwih₁ moy tr̥mtés. deywṓs nos ḱósmi dinóy lubʰyónti. ḱósmi h₂ḱméni sddʰí kʷih₁dʰí-kʷe.
english: Is the ice on the river strong? Will it hold us up? It holds up a wagon. Yesterday a man drove his own wagon over it. Then let us cross it quickly. Listen! The ice is splitting! Run, and do not stand! We have got through! My knees are trembling. The gods love us on this day. Sit on this stone and rest.

pie: méh₂ter nos dṓm h₂usési linékʷmi. dʰúgh₂ter mē HréwdHs. pótis toy h₁wésus h₁ésyo-kʷe ḱóymos ne kʷelsós. h₂ew te kʷéḱoh₂? wésni twé próti gʷm̥yṓh₂. ḱód péh₃tlom h₁áyso h₁ésmōd píph₃e memóntu-kʷe me. dweh₂róysu te pn̥th₁sú meménoh₂. h₂éwsōs toy h₁iméni lukyéh₁t.
english: Mother, at dawn I leave our house. Do not weep, daughter. Your husband is good, and his village is not distant. Shall I see you again? In spring I will come to you. Take this cup, drink from it, and remember me. On long roads I will remember you. May Dawn grow bright on your way!

pie: kʷís gʰóstey túH? h₁eǵóh₂ h₁sn̥tyóḱlewēs. kʷíd toy gʷḗn h₁nómn̥? h₁eǵóh₂ h₁suménēs. bʰréh₂tr̥s moy dṓm h₁r̥sḱóh₂. kúdʰe toy bʰréh₂tēr tḱéyti? déh₂newi méǵh₂i h₂ḱméni h₁épi tḱéyti. tóm h₂éḱmonm̥ wóydh₂e. ḱóm h₁éyowos. nu h₁sń̥tyoḱlewes h₁éyowos.
english: Stranger, who are you? I am Of-True-Fame. Woman, what is your name? I am Kindly. I am going to my brother's house. Where does your brother dwell? He dwells by the river, near a great stone. I know that stone. Let us go together. Then let us go, Of-True-Fame.

pie: wíḱpotey me h₃rḗǵs twé próti sélǵt. dʰh₁tléh₂m tritóy dinóy gʷm̥dʰí. kʷíd h₃rḗǵs wiHróns wéḱti? póyḱōs déh₂nu tr̥h₂ént gʷṓs-kʷe sl̥h₂gʷént. kʷóti póyḱōs h₁sénti? ḱm̥tóm póyḱōs h₁sénti. bʰréh₂tr̥bʰis moy ḱóm gʷm̥yṓh₂. h₁íns déh₂nu upér ǵʰéyomes. h₃rēǵéy ḱód mluHdʰí.
english: Lord, the king has sent me to you. On the third day come to the assembly. Why does the king want the men? Enemies have crossed the river and seized cattle. How many enemies are there? There are a hundred enemies. I will come with my brothers. We will drive them on over the river. Say this to the king.

pie: kʷís ǵérh₂ont túH wésmn̥ toy dért. h₁eǵóh₂ ń̥ḱoymos póyḱōs moy ḱóymom h₁éwsont. kúdʰe kʷsépi sési? drúsu Hn̥dʰí sésmi h₂stéres-kʷe me spéḱyonti. túH ne somHós? h₁eǵóh₂ somHós h₂óǵmos moy priHós. spélom nos wéwkēsi? téḱneh₂ sísdete ḱléwsete-kʷe. h₃érō poh₂iménm̥ bʰérǵʰuh₂ pérwōr upér wéǵʰet.
english: Old man, who are you? Your garment is torn. I am homeless: enemies burned my village. Where do you sleep at night? I sleep under the trees, and the stars look at me. Are you not alone? I am alone; the road is my friend. Will you tell us a tale? Sit down, children, and listen. An eagle was carrying a shepherd over the high mountains.

pie: méh₂ter sréwmn̥ ḱolHtóm h₂erHmóysu me toy bʰére. úd stigʰdʰí ḱérh₂sonm̥-kʷe moy kapyé. lówksneh₂m sruméni widéh₁yoh₂. ní mē spéḱyes h₂éḱmonn̥s spéḱye. méh₂ter sruméns dedwóyth₂e? h₁yód séngʷesi séngʷowos. kapyṓh₂ te th₂kéh₁yōh₂-kʷe. nu pr̥wé.
english: Mother, the stream is cold: carry me on your shoulders. Climb up, and hold my head. I see the moon in the stream! Do not look down: look at the stones. Are you afraid of the stream, mother? If you fall, we will both fall. I will hold you, and I will be silent. Now we have got across.

pie: h₂énHe m̥ǵh₂és déh₂nus nésm̥. népot moy ḱḗr méwdeti. kʷíd h₂óǵmoy dedórḱth₂e? néh₂wn̥s h₁r̥h₁yóntn̥s-kʷe wiHróns dedórḱh₂e. nu déh₂nu tl̥h₂tóh₁ pérm̥. ne bʰebʰóyh₂th₂e? ne bʰebʰóyh₂h₂e h₂éwh₂os moy ǵʰóstom dʰoréyet. kéh₂nmn̥ déh₂newi ḱléws h₁íd moy gʷéHye.
english: Grandmother, I have come home safe from the great river! Grandson, my heart rejoices. What have you seen on the way? I have seen boats and rowing men. Then I crossed the river by a bridge. Were you not afraid? I was not afraid: my uncle held my hand. You heard a song on the river: sing it to me.

pie: swésor stóygʰom témHesi ne widéh₁yoh₂. h₁énom h₂stérm̥ lewkóm úd spéḱye. h₁éy nos ḱóymoy upér stestóh₂e. kʷíh₁ h₁ím wóydth₂e? h₁yód téḱnom h₁ésm̥ h₂éwh₂os nos moy h₁ím déyḱet. h₁ím sékʷeso h₂Hséh₂i-kʷe h₂éyeri h₁ésowos. gʷéHye moy ne-kʷe bʰéyh₂oh₂. poh₂iménes kéh₂nmn̥ séngʷʰōh₂.
english: Sister, in the darkness I do not see the path. Look up at that star, the bright one. It stands above our village. How do you know it? When I was a child, our grandfather showed it to me. Follow it, and in the morning we will be at the hearth. Sing to me, and I will not be afraid. I will sing the song of the shepherds.

pie: príHe nos stéygʰh₁e h₁idʰé wí ih₂tés. túH móri yéh₂si h₁eǵóh₂-kʷe pérwōr yéh₂mi. kʷóm h₂ew réh₁towos? dh₂pnóy ǵʰiméni réh₁towos. ḱóm ǵʰoysóm h₁áyso h₁iméni te h₂léksoyh₁t. túH moy ḱéstrom h₁áyso. deywṓs toy HeHḱúh₁ pódh₁e dh₃ih₁ént. bʰóros toy péh₂uros h₁syéh₁t. príHe kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí.
english: Friend, here our two paths go apart. You are going to the sea, and I to the mountains. When shall we meet again? We shall meet at the feast in winter. Take this spear: may it protect you on the way. And you, take my knife. May the gods give you swift feet! And may your load be small! Be well, friend!

pie: owis, yāi wl̥nā ne eest, dedorḱe eḱwons, tom woǵʰom gʷr̥um weǵʰontm̥, tom bʰorom meǵm̥, tom ǵʰm̥onm̥ ōku bʰerontm̥.
english: A sheep that had no wool saw horses, one of them pulling a heavy wagon, one carrying a big load, and one carrying a man quickly.

pie: gʰóstey dweh₂róysu h₂óǵmoysu stéygʰes spélom nos wr̥h₁dʰí. tewh₂téh₂ pl̥th₂enéh₂i dʰǵʰémi wóǵʰoysu h₂ewsér gʷíh₃weti. ḱóymōs h₁éymos ne h₁sénti. swṓm stéh₂dʰh₁ōm h₂mélǵos píph₃onti mḗms-kʷe gʷr̥h₃ónti. h₁éyes gʰostíbʰos ḱéywōs? ḱéywōs moy h₁sént h₁éysōm moy wiḱpótis pṓlHom déh₃t. nu kúdʰe só pṓlHos h₁ésti? h₁éy toy h₂éǵroy stestóh₂e nu h₂wékst.
english: Guest, you have walked on long ways: tell us a tale. Toward the dawn, on the wide earth, a people lives on wagons. They have no villages. They drink the milk of their own herds and eat flesh. Are they friendly to guests? They were friendly to me: their chief gave me a foal. Where is that foal now? It stands in your pasture: now it has grown big.

pie: gʷḗn h₃sléydʰm̥. kʷóteros stéyks pérwr̥ h₁éyti? sewyóh₁ stigʰéh₁ ih₂dʰí. h₁étereh₂bʰos pérwr̥ h₁éyti. nu wódr̥ bʰr̥h₁wéns ph₃dʰí tr̥syési. wódr̥ sweh₂dú ḱolHtóm-kʷe. kʷís pr̥wéni tḱéyti? bʰréh₂tēr moy h₂én tḱéyti. h₁ésmey wr̥h₁dʰí. swésōr toy kéh₂ileh₂. h₁ésmey wérh₁oh₂.
english: Woman, I have gone astray. Which of the two paths goes to the ford? Go by the left path. The other one goes to the mountain. Now drink water from the spring: you are thirsty. The water is sweet and cold. Who lives at the ford? My brother lives there. Say to him: Your sister is well. I will say it to him.

pie: pótey h₂egʰóm súpniyom ḱósyeh₂i kʷsépi kʷéḱm̥. h₁iméni ḱéyth₂e ne-kʷe gʷíh₃wes. súpniyeh₂ dʰrugʰyéti. ǵʰóstom moy h₁pdʰí gʷíh₃woh₂. dweh₂róm wóyḱom mē gʷéh₂s. wiḱpótis me wéḱti. gʷéh₂oh₂ nésoh₂-kʷe. kʷóm nésēth₂er? pr̥h₂wóh₁ snóygʷʰoh₁ nésōh₂er. deywṓs te h₂léksoyh₁ent ménōh₂-kʷe te.
english: Husband, this night I saw an evil dream. You were lying on the way, and you were not alive. Dreams deceive. Grasp my hand: I am alive. Do not go to the far settlement! The clan chief wants me. I will go, and I will come back unharmed. When will you return home? I will return home with the first snow. May the gods protect you, and I will wait for you.

pie: gʷénh₂es h₁éǵʰs h₁n̥dʰté h₂néres nos póyḱons unént. kʷís ḱód sokʷéyet? h₃reyHdʰónts mórtos déh₂nus h₁ludʰét. pótis moy gʷíh₃weti? gʷíh₃weti póyḱōs h₁ésyo skélos tr̥h₃ént. dʰúgh₂teres wódr̥ gʷʰr̥nuté h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m-kʷe bʰérete. h₂néres póntoh₁i kh₂nówos. kh₂nṓmes dh₂pnóm-kʷe h₂réydʰōmes.
english: Women, come out! Our men have overcome the enemies. Who said this? A riding man arrived from the river. Is my husband alive? He is alive; the enemies wounded his leg. Daughters, heat water and bring wool! The men are singing on the road. Let us sing, and let us prepare a feast.
